user.title: Library card
user.description: Card number and password of the Münchner Stadtbibliothek account (the same as for the online catalog).

data_description.name: Shown as device name, e.g. the card holder. Useful with several cards.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The catalog rejected the password for {name}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Card number or password is wrong.
error.unknown_page: The catalog answered with an unexpected page ({details}).

abort.already_configured: This card is already set up.

init.title: Options
init.description: Every update logs in to the catalog once and out again. Due dates rarely change, a few hours are enough.

data_description.lookup_covers: Searches every new item once in the catalog (title, shelf mark, library), loads its cover and stores it in Home Assistant. Three extra page loads per new item.

loan_gone.message: This item is no longer on the card.

auth_failed.message: The catalog rejected the login. Please enter the password again.

renew_running.message: A renewal of this item is already running.
